name: Bes
body:
Known as the Happy God, The Prankster, and The Guardian Fool, Bes enjoys loud music, wild dancing, gambling, humor, and celebrations of all kinds. Bes’s antics are thought to frighten away evil spirits, making him the perfect protector of pregnant women and newly birthed infants.

Bes appears as a short, rotund, humanoid male with a big belly and pronounced breasts.

He has a large head, a bushy beard, a tail, a prominent, flat nose, and protruding ears. With bent legs, Bes stands clad in a lion-skin pelt with his genitals exposed and his tongue sticking out.

Bes wears a crown of feathers upon his head.

Pregnant women, gamblers, mischief-makers, and rapscallions of all kinds turn to Bes for his blessings.

Merriment

Granted Powers: Laughter is your medicine of choice.

Your magic is whimsical, focusing on jokes and protection against evil. Non-evil, non-lawful prankster-deities offer this domain.

Prankster (Sp)

As a swift action, you can target one 5-foot square within 30 feet of you.

The square becomes covered in grease for 1 round and is treated as difficult terrain. All creatures wholly or partly in the square must immediately make a successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your cleric level + your Wisdom modifier) or fall prone. At 6th level, you can target two 5-foot squares (within range) at once with this ability. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

The Joke Is On You (Ex)

At 8th level, the saving throw DC for any spell you cast from the illusion school is increased by 2, and all saving throws you make against illusions gain a +4 sacred bonus.

Domain: 1st-protection from evil, 2ndhideous laughter, 3rd-audiovisual hallucination, 4th-bountiful banquet, 5th-jester’s jaunt, 6thjoyful rapture, 7th-waves of ecstasy, 8thirresistible dance, 9th-freedom.
